response: The affinity column-mediated immunoassay (ACMIA) method is suitable as an alternative to the microparticle enzyme immunoassay (MEIA) method as a blood tacrolimus assay. The ACMIA method is precise and has several advantages, including the lack of a required pretreatment procedure. Additionally, it is only slightly influenced by the hematologic or biochemical status of the samples, making it a reliable option for measuring tacrolimus levels in blood.
